title: Operational dashboard and outstanding department tasks
purpose: The dashboard brings together operational counts, department actions and project budget positions. This stage includes an approved PO awaiting Procurement issuance.
caption: Figure 1. Operational dashboard and outstanding department tasks

title: Project budget and scope allocation
purpose: Project details show the overall allocation, commitments, spending and available funds, with an Architectural scope linked to MRF 372.
caption: Figure 2. Project budget and scope allocation

title: Material request quantities and approval controls
purpose: The Project Manager checks eight requested materials, quantities, required dates, delivery locations and site stock before approving, returning or rejecting the request. The same record retains the source reference and supporting MRF, key plan and scope PDF.
caption: Figure 3. Material request quantities and approval controls

title: Approved purchase order and supplier issuance controls
purpose: Procurement confirms issuance of an Accounting-approved and archived purchase order. The selected PO covers seven requested materials from Kestrel.
caption: Figure 4. Approved purchase order and supplier issuance controls

title: Supplier directory populated from reviewed quotations
purpose: The supplier directory contains Meridian, Apex, Summit and Kestrel from the four reviewed sample quotations, with access to quotation history.
caption: Figure 5. Supplier directory populated from reviewed quotations

title: Purchase order costing and budget approval
purpose: Accounting checks the supplier material costs, net payable and available project and Architectural scope funds before approving the Apex credit PO. Withholding reduces the supplier payable from the VAT-inclusive material total.
caption: Figure 6. Purchase order costing and budget approval

title: External supplier payment coordination
purpose: Finance coordinates an external supplier payment using priority, processing status, planned payment date and notes. Scheduled coordination does not establish verified payment.
caption: Figure 7. External supplier payment coordination

title: Site receiving and accepted delivery quantities
purpose: Site Personnel confirms received quantities against a dispatched supplier delivery and records any shortage or damage before a separate stock-posting step.
caption: Figure 8. Site receiving and accepted delivery quantities

title: Inter-project stock transfer and delivery trip
purpose: A source-approved transfer moves four matching glass clamps from Cavite to Marina Skyline. Logistics records dispatch separately from destination receiving and posting.
caption: Figure 9. Inter-project stock transfer and delivery trip

title: Project stock after receipts transfers and usage
purpose: The stock register shows the destination project’s posted supplier and transfer receipts after usage. Its 60 clamps combine 56 purchased pieces and four transferred pieces.
caption: Figure 10. Project stock after receipts transfers and usage

title: Management purchasing budget and workflow report
purpose: Management reports consolidate project funding, purchasing volume, workflow status and exceptions for the connected MRF 372 transactions.
caption: Figure 11. Management purchasing budget and workflow report

title: Department users and site project assignments
purpose: Administrator manages named department accounts and assigns Site Personnel to projects. The example shows the destination and source projects assigned to the site account.
caption: Figure 12. Department users and site project assignments

title: Supplier quotation review beside the original PDF
purpose: Procurement checks Kestrel’s original quotation alongside the offered-material worksheet, confirming material links, quantities and prices before finalization.
caption: Figure 13. Supplier quotation review beside the original PDF

title: Comparative bidding and saved supplier awards
purpose: Four supplier quotations support the comparison. The native horizontally scrolling table is positioned to show the winning Kestrel prices and saved awards. Apex supplies 56 clamps, Kestrel supplies the other seven materials, and four clamps come from site stock.

uiChecks.message: Winning supplier columns are visible in the native comparison

caption: Figure 14. Comparative bidding and saved supplier awards

title: Grouped material usage and recorded responsibility
purpose: One immutable usage entry records two installed glass panels and one silicone cartridge, with a shared explanation, material-specific reasons, named actor and timestamp.
caption: Figure 15. Grouped material usage and recorded responsibility

title: Material consumption and closing stock reconciliation
purpose: The glass-material filter shows source and destination stock together: four clamps transferred out of the source, 60 clamps at the destination, and two panels used with 10 remaining. The report reconciles an inclusive Philippine date range.

uiChecks.message: Consumption displays usage and transfer arithmetic together

caption: Figure 16. Material consumption and closing stock reconciliation
